intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Ciel turns the monitor toward you without looking up.

teach0.speaker: cpp
teach0.text: Comments. The compiler deletes them before it does anything else. Zero cost. My favorite kind of feature.

teach1.speaker: cpp
teach1.text: Two slashes for one line. Slash star, star slash for a block. That's it. That's the lesson.

teach2.speaker: cpp
teach2.text: My debug line is printing. Comment it out. Do not delete it. I'll need it at 3 a.m., and I'm not typing it again.

passed.speaker: cpp
passed.text: ...Fine. It's clean. The debug line is still there for when I need it. You didn't break anything. That's rare.

failed.speaker: cpp
failed.text: It's still printing garbage. Look at what you wrote. Then sit down and try again.

bye.speaker: cpp
bye.text: Whatever. The lab's open. Not that I'm waiting.
